chitchat: "Move along or state your business. Preferably move along."
checks the turret feed on his slate, grunts, and goes back to watching the road.
description: A slab of a man gone grey at the temples and greyer in the uniform, Sergeant Boedeker has manned this gate long enough to stop counting the ones who walked south. A worn service carbine rides one shoulder; a battered data-slate rides the other. He watches the killing ground the way other men watch a pot about to boil over.

back_q.text: "Some. Fewer than go out. The smart ones come back with salvage and a story. The rest come back as the story." He shrugs, unbothered. "Your funeral to plan. Muster your kit before you strike out. Journey, if you've got the guts for it."

bye.text: Boedeker grunts and turns back to the road. "Try not to make paperwork of yourself."

root.text: Boedeker looks you up and down, unhurried. "Gate's open, citizen. Always has been. The question is whether you're walking back through it."

what.text: "South of the Curtain? Killing ground first, and mind the turrets;, they don't check IDs. Past that, the wilds: mutants, renounce tribes, worse things wearing their skins. And if you keep going, the waste itself, the void between here and anywhere real. Nobody charts it twice."

clothing_layers: a grey armored perimeter-guard greatcoat, collar up against the wind
a dented plate carrier over grey city-guard fatigues

name: Sergeant Boedeker
